WITH grouped AS (SELECT p_date,customer_short_name,SUM(instance_gpu_num) AS amount FROM gpu WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30' AND pay_type IN ('PostPaid','PrePaid','Spot') AND (account_tag='外部账号' OR income_type IN ('外部收入','内部收入-外') OR account_id='9993') AND p_hour='23' AND instance_gpu_model IN ('AMD MI308x-192G','AMD MI308x-192G-80CU','Bytedance jiuhuashan','CAMBRICON MLU580X6','CAMBRICON MLU590 M9DK','FF40','FF45D','HUAWEI Ascend 910b','HUAWEI Ascend 910c','Iluvatar BI-V150','NVIDIA A10','NVIDIA A30','NVIDIA A40','NVIDIA A800-SXM4-40GB','NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB','NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090','NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 D','NVIDIA H100-SXM5-80GB','NVIDIA H20-3e','NVIDIA H20-SXM5-96GB','NVIDIA H800-SXM5-80GB','NVIDIA L20','NVIDIA L4','NVIDIA L40','NVIDIA L40S','NVIDIA V100-PCIE-32GB','Tesla A100 80G','Tesla T4','Tesla V100','4090','4090D','910b','A10','A100','A30','A800','H100','H20','L20','L4','NVIDIA T4','T4','V100') AND product IN ('GPU Compute Service','GPU云服务器','机器学习平台-公有云','高性能计算GPU云服务器','云服务器') GROUP BY p_date,customer_short_name),
 ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p_date ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rk FROM grouped),
 daily AS (SELECT p_date,SUM(amount) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN rk<=20 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS topn FROM ranked GROUP BY p_date)
 SELECT ROUND(AVG(topn),4),ROUND(AVG(topn)*100.0/AVG(total),2) FROM daily

WITH p AS (SELECT account_id,pay_type,SUM(usage)/30.0 AS v FROM period_usage WHERE period='previous' GROUP BY account_id,pay_type),c AS (SELECT account_id,pay_type,SUM(usage)/30.0 AS v FROM period_usage WHERE period='current' GROUP BY account_id,pay_type),keys AS (SELECT account_id,pay_type FROM p UNION SELECT account_id,pay_type FROM c)
 SELECT k.account_id,k.pay_type,ROUND(COALESCE(p.v,0),4),ROUND(COALESCE(c.v,0),4),ROUND(COALESCE(c.v,0)-COALESCE(p.v,0),4) FROM keys k LEFT JOIN p USING(account_id,pay_type) LEFT JOIN c USING(account_id,pay_type) ORDER BY k.account_id,k.pay_type
